name: Mail Agent
lede: An email agent that learns how you handle your inbox, then does it for you.
summary: An email assistant that learns how you handle your inbox and then does it for you. It runs on your Mac, and its AI can run there too, so your mail never has to leave your computer.
description: Mail Agent is a private email assistant for the Mac. It learns how you handle your inbox from plain-English answers and then does it for you, with AI that can run entirely on your computer.

items.title: Reads each new email
items.text: It works out what the email is and what is in it: a promotion, a bill, a coupon code, a deadline.

items.title: Asks once, in plain English
items.text: For an email it has not seen before, it asks what to do. Your answer becomes a rule.

items.title: Handles the rest
items.text: Clear matches are handled automatically. When a rule only partly fits, it asks instead of guessing.

screenshot.alt: Mail Agent in auto mode, working through a demo inbox: three emails handled automatically, two skipped for later, and to-dos for two bills added on the right.

aside: One of the small tools I build on the side because I want to use them myself.
